Senior Data Analyst

Brightwater Energy is growing its analytics team in Melbourne. You'll turn customer and network data into clear decisions for our operations leaders, working closely with engineers and the leadership team.

What you'll do

  • Build and maintain dashboards in Power BI for the operations team
  • Write SQL to pull and clean data from our warehouse
  • Present findings to people who aren't data specialists

What you'll bring

  • Five or more years in a data analyst role
  • Strong SQL, and Power BI or Tableau

To apply, send your resume to careers@brightwater.example before the end of November.
